messages:
Ivy (AE): Prospect (payments company) wants BYO-HSM POC. Requirements: monthly rotation, signed HSM attestation monthly, 48h rollback window, and explicit SOW exclusion that Redwood never has access to unwrapped KEKs. Need feasibility + rough pricing.
Cal (Solutions): All feasible. Two patterns: (A) Proxy-mode: Redwood forwards crypto ops to customer KMS over mTLS; we never persist KEK plaintext. (B) Envelope-mode: customer uploads wrapped DEKs; Redwood operates on wrapped keys. Tradeoffs: proxy = added latency + network work; envelope = customer ops responsibility on rotation.
Rina (SE): Engineering needs attestation metadata schema. Suggest fields: signer_id, hsm_model, report_sha256, signature_b64, timestamp, ceremony_id. Also an endpoint to upload wrapped_dek with metadata for envelope-mode.
Tom (CryptoOps): For acceptance: we can accept vendor-signed attestation PDF/blob plus SHA256 fingerprint and HSM serial. For split custody, accept N-of-M signed artifacts but customer must define aggregation. Rotation: we can trigger via their rotate API (proxy) or swap to pre-staged wrapped_dek_vN (envelope). Need drain semantics to avoid decrypting with old DEK.
Hana (Legal): Contract side: we will add "no long-term access" clause and a KEK-loss carve-out. Also require minimum attestation contents and an agreed emergency rekey/runbook for the 48h rollback. Customer retention: they must retain full attestation blobs; Redwood will store verification hashes only.
net-bot: Created staging proxy tunnels (2x) for payments-poc in us-east-1. Latency probe scheduled.
Ivy (AE): Actions: Cal to produce two diagrams + cost worksheet for 200k tokens/day; Tom to draft rotation runbook and required attestation fields; Hana to draft SOW language. Will follow up with prospect after artifacts.
Cal (Solutions): I'll post the diagrams and sample calc by EOD.
Tom (CryptoOps): Runbook draft in 24h.
Hana (Legal): SOW draft coming in GH for review.
Ivy (AE): Thanks team. Will keep thread open for customer replies. :thumbsup:
